description: Deterministic, headless layered left-to-right layout for BPMN models that carry no (or incomplete) BPMNDI diagram data. Pools render as stacked horizontal bands with lanes stacked inside them; the token flow runs from left to right in longest-path layers; containers are sized to fit their contents. Pure functions over ModelingModelDto — no JS interop, no UI dependency, no randomness and no clock: the same model always produces the same view, so the output is safe for golden tests and server-side use.
